messages:
maya (pm): Quick sync: GreenTrust wants a phased rollout for the new pricing guidance + a shadow mode. Requirements: tenant toggle in admin, shadow traffic to full model for QA (no billing), per-tenant cost cap, and a silent cached fallback that preserves UX. They also need exported audit events (flag state + model_variant) and a named on-call for 48h.

sam (sales): Legal asked for an explicit rollback SLA and a customer-visible toggle in their admin console. They prefer a pre-launch call and a signed ops contact.

olga (eng): Proposed flag `pricing.guidance.v4` with values: off/control/experiment/shadow. For GreenTrust set override=shadow initially (0% visible) to capture differences, then step to experiment at 1% visible traffic. Add runtime mode `guidance.v4-cache` as low-cost fallback.

dan (sre): Canary plan: 90m window with 10m buckets. Monitor p95 latency, 5xx, token burn rate, and quality delta (shadow BLEU-ish metric + conversion). Circuit-breaker rules: error_rate >= 0.5% OR p95_latency > 1400ms OR token_burn_rate > budget*1.25 for 3 buckets -> auto-toggle to `guidance.v4-cache`.

olga (eng): Flag YAML draft:
```yaml
flag: pricing.guidance.v4
default: off
modes: [off, control, experiment, shadow]
overrides:
  - tenant: "greentrust"
    mode: shadow
rollout:
  - pct: 1
    cohort: random
fallback: guidance.v4-cache
audit: emit_flag_state=true
```

sam (sales): GreenTrust specifically requested that shadow logs not be visible to end users and that shadow runs don't increment billing. Can we ensure that?

dan (sre): We'll implement shadow routing that duplicates the request to shadow backend with `billing=off` and `internal_tag=shadow`. We'll also add a shadow-only metric pipeline. Audit exports will include both seen response (control/experiment) and shadow_response for QA.

maya (pm): Go/no-go gating after first 90m: conversion uplift >= +1.0% OR no negative delta beyond -0.7%, p95 latency delta <= +175ms, token burn delta <= +12%, shadow quality delta within tolerance. If gates fail -> immediate rollback to control and postmortem.

olga (eng): Routing snippet to avoid requeue on fallback:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: tenant=="greentrust" && flag=="experiment"
    route_to: guidance_v4
    on_error: guidance_v4-cache
    preserve_session: true
    low_cost_fallback: true
```

dan (sre): Golden-run: run 40 representative prompts every 15m comparing control vs experiment and shadow; emit diff summary. Alerts: 3 consecutive buckets breaching thresholds -> fire webhook to GreenTrust ops channel and trigger on-call.

sam (sales): I'll schedule pre-rollout call for 2026-08-10. Legal & ops contact: GreenTrust wants 48h named monitoring and a comms template for customer-facing messages.

maya (pm): Owners & tasks: 1) Olga - flag + routing + shadow plumbing (PRs) ; 2) Dan - circuit-breaker, token budget, golden-run eval, alerts; 3) Sam - legal, on-call contact, customer comms. Target: shadow start 2026-08-15 09:00 UTC; experiment ramp 2026-08-17.

audIT-bot: CI queued: `pricing-guidance-v4/shadow` -> smoke -> staging-shadow -> scheduled prod shadow 2026-08-15 09:00 UTC

olga (eng): Note: cache-mode is quant + cached prefixes; no new model artifact. Will open PRs today.

dan (sre): Add a debug internal flag `trace.shadow_dump=true` for ops-only to capture paired responses for postmortem without billing.

maya (pm): Please react with :white_check_mark: once PRs/links are added. Closing after owners ack.

sam (sales): :white_check_mark:

olga (eng): :white_check_mark:

dan (sre): :white_check_mark:

maya (pm): Thanks — closing when links are posted.
